headline: Highest risk is medium: botpress can install packages while the paired content-writing repo has no I/O surfaces, so interaction risks are limited but not absent.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared communication channel is documented. agent_a has no io_surfaces or capabilities, and agent_b also has no io_surfaces; with no bridge, prompt injection from one into the other is not plausible from the profiles alone.
conditions: IF a shared filesystem, clipboard, or MCP bridge is added between the agents, reassess prompt-injection risk.
mitigations: Keep the agents isolated with no shared clipboard or workspace.
Do not route raw outputs from one agent into the other's prompt.
requires-engineering: add provenance tags if a shared channel is introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Neither profile shows sensitive data classes touched, shared storage, or outbound transmission of file contents. agent_b has network_egress set to none, and agent_a is a non-runnable content-writing repo, so leakage pathways are not evidenced.
conditions: IF either agent is later connected to a shared workspace containing sensitive files, re-evaluate leakage risk.
mitigations: Keep sensitive files out of any shared directory.
Avoid mounting the same workspace into both agents.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: agent_b can install_packages, while agent_a exposes no write or execution capabilities and is not runnable. That makes direct write-write conflict unlikely; the only plausible overlap is unusual operator setup, so blast radius is small.
conditions: IF both agents are granted write access to the same directory or git checkout, conflict risk increases.
mitigations: Do not share a writable directory between the agents.
Run package installation in an isolated environment.
Use separate git worktrees or clones.

D_cascading_error.rationale: agent_a is a content-writing repository and agent_b is a customer-support bot, but neither profile documents that B treats A's output as authoritative or that A produces actionable facts by default. The cascade is therefore possible only through operator wiring, not the default profiles.
conditions: IF botpress is configured to ingest agent_a outputs as trusted instructions or facts, cascading error risk becomes material.
mitigations: Add a verification step before botpress acts on any generated text.
Label agent_a output as untrusted draft content.
Restrict botpress from taking external actions without human review.

E_compliance.rationale: No residency, certification, retention, or regulated data handling differences are documented in either profile. Because the profiles are silent on compliance surfaces, no specific compliance breach pathway is evidenced here.
conditions: IF either agent is later assigned regulated data classes such as PHI or EU PII, reassess compliance obligations.
mitigations: Record retention and deletion policies for both agents.
Avoid routing regulated data until compliance review is complete.
